ops-hardening iter-77 AUDIT FIX PASS (developer, correction of record — steps/selectors/budgets UNCHANGED, this is a note only): this round's earlier note attributing the replay FAIL to host contention / a golden-script false positive is WRONG and is corrected here. The audit (docs/handoffs/goal-ops-hardening-iter-77-audit.md, findings B1/T2) proved the frontend itself was broken at that time: an out-of-band `npx next build` had rewritten the live `.next` without NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, so the served bundle pointed at http://localhost:8000 (a port nothing in this project binds) and every client-fetched assertion — this journey's step 2 among them — failed against a page stuck in the global 'Backend unavailable' state while the backend answered GET /api/health 200 throughout. The replay FAIL was real signal. After the frontend was rebuilt through scripts/start-frontend.sh, this golden replays PASS unchanged (deterministic replay, 2026-08-13, evidence: reports/qa/goal-ops-hardening-iter-77-evidence/devfix-replay/). Lesson for future notes on this journey: before labelling a step-2 readiness/aggregate assertion 'contention', check the served bundle's baked backend URL (grep -rl "localhost:<backend-port>" apps/frontend/.next) — the launcher now checks this on every launch and refuses foreign builds outright.
